panels.title: How to read this dashboard (read-only verification)

options.content:
**Time range = the test window.** Set `from` about 1 minute before the scale-down was triggered and `to=now`. Every *verdict* table uses the whole range (`$__range`).

**Read the verdicts only after the system has settled:** Terminating = 0, total pending/buffer = 0, remote storage and rotel up, and about 60 s more for logs to reach ClickHouse.

| Check | PASS | FAIL |
|---|---|---|
| **V1** vmagent preStop drain (one row per pod instance) | every `REMOVED` row is `DRAINED`; survivors show `SURVIVOR` | a `REMOVED` row ends in `TIMEOUT`, `SKIPPED` or `unknown` |
| **V2** vmagent data continuity (max gap between stored samples, per avalanche target) | every target <= 15 s (5 s scrape; reshard handover up to ~8.5 s) | any target > 15 s: samples queued on a removed shard never reached storage |
| **V3** Vector shutdown (one row per pod instance) | `Vector has stopped.` with no forced kill | `Failed to gracefully shut down in time`: the buffer is left on the PVC |
| **V4** loggen end-to-end completeness (seq gaps per loggen pod) | `missing` = 0 | `missing` > 0 once every Vector buffer is 0 |

Live tables, such as *Per-pod queue now*, show the current state. Timeseries panels are for screenshots; to read a timeseries as numbers, use panel menu → Inspect → Data.

panels.title: Metrics data age (VictoriaMetrics)
panels.description: Age of the newest sample. The monitoring stack shares what the lab breaks: during a VictoriaMetrics outage every metric panel freezes at its last value; during a rotel/ClickHouse outage every log panel freezes. Above the red threshold, treat that datasource's live panels as stale.

panels.title: Logs data age (ClickHouse)
panels.description: Age of the newest sample. The monitoring stack shares what the lab breaks: during a VictoriaMetrics outage every metric panel freezes at its last value; during a rotel/ClickHouse outage every log panel freezes. Above the red threshold, treat that datasource's live panels as stale.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dateDiff('second', max(Timestamp), now64()) AS age_s
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE

panels.title: Pods per shardCount (rolling progress)
panels.description: Running pods grouped by the -promscrape.cluster.membersCount flag they were started with. During a reshard, old and new values coexist; when it is done, one value remains with 2 pods per shard.

panels.title: Desired shards (KEDA HPA)
panels.description: HPA desired replicas = VMAgent shardCount. While KEDA is paused (make pin), this can show the last value or nothing.

panels.title: Total pending bytes (all pods)
panels.description: In-memory + on-disk queue of every lab vmagent pod (scraped every 20s).

panels.title: Per-pod queue now (vmagent)
panels.description: memberNum >= shardCount means the pod belongs to a REMOVED shard and must drain before it exits.

targets.expr: (max by (pod) (kube_pod_deletion_timestamp{namespace="vmagent-lab", pod=~"vmagent-lab-.*"}) > bool 0) or on (pod) (max by (pod) (up{job="vmagent-lab"}) * 0)

panels.title: Total pending bytes per pod (in-memory + disk)
panels.description: A removed shard's pods must reach 0 here before they disappear (the line ends at 0).

panels.title: Drain progress now (preStop log, last 2 min; works while VictoriaMetrics is down)
panels.description: During a remote-storage outage every VictoriaMetrics panel freezes, because the monitoring vmagent writes to the same VMCluster. The preStop drain loop logs its state every 2 s through the logs pipeline (ClickHouse), so this table stays live: total_pending_bytes must fall to 0 and quiet must reach 15/15s before the pod exits. Empty = no pod is draining right now.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pod,
  max(ts) AS last_line_at,
  argMax(toUInt32OrZero(extract(Body, 'elapsed=(\\d+)s')), ts) AS elapsed_seconds,
  argMax(toUInt64OrZero(extract(Body, 'total_pending_bytes=(\\d+)')), ts) AS total_pending_bytes,
  argMax(toUInt64OrZero(extract(Body, 'failures=(\\d+)')), ts) AS retry_error_counter,
  argMax(extract(Body, 'quiet=(\\S+)'), ts) AS quiet
FROM (
  SELECT extract(Body, 'prestop-drain pod=(\\S+)') AS pod, Timestamp AS ts, Body
  FROM otel.otel_logs
  WHERE Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE
    AND match(Body, '^\\S+Z prestop-drain pod=')
      AND LogAttributes['k8s.container.name'] != 'inspect'  -- scripts/lab/inspect-pvc.sh re-prints old drain logs
    AND Body LIKE '%total_pending_bytes=%'
)
GROUP BY pod
ORDER BY pod

panels.title: V1 vmagent preStop drain verdict (one row per pod instance)
panels.description: Parsed from the prestop-drain log lines (container stdout -> fluent-bit -> Vector -> rotel -> ClickHouse). REMOVED + DRAINED = PASS. SURVIVOR = survivor shard; its PVC is reattached and replayed, so it does not drain. max_total_pending_bytes > 0 proves the drain had work to do; 0 means the queue was already empty when preStop started (the test did not exercise the drain). One row per pod instance: a pod name is reused by every roll, so lines are split into sessions by a > 30 s gap. With DRAIN_MODE=skip there is no role line, so every row is FAIL by design.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pod,
  min(ts) AS prestop_start,
  max(ts) AS prestop_end,
  multiIf(countIf(Body LIKE '%shard is REMOVED%') > 0, 'REMOVED',
          countIf(Body LIKE '%shard SURVIVES%') > 0, 'SURVIVOR', 'unknown') AS role,
  anyIf(extract(Body, 'start mode=(\\S+)'), Body LIKE '%start mode=%') AS mode,
  multiIf(countIf(Body LIKE '%DRAINED after%') > 0, 'DRAINED',
          countIf(Body LIKE '%TIMEOUT after%') > 0, 'TIMEOUT',
          countIf(Body LIKE '%skip drain%') > 0, 'SKIPPED', 'IN PROGRESS') AS result,
  max(toUInt64OrZero(extract(Body, 'total_pending_bytes=(\\d+)'))) AS max_total_pending_bytes,
  argMaxIf(toUInt64OrZero(extract(Body, 'total_pending_bytes=(\\d+)')), ts,
           Body LIKE '%total_pending_bytes=%') AS last_total_pending_bytes,
  multiIf(role = 'REMOVED' AND result = 'DRAINED', 'PASS',
          role = 'SURVIVOR' AND result = 'SKIPPED', 'SURVIVOR',
          result = 'IN PROGRESS', 'WAIT',
          'FAIL') AS verdict
FROM (
  SELECT pod, ts, Body,
    sum(is_new) OVER (PARTITION BY pod ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session
  FROM (
    SELECT extract(Body, 'prestop-drain pod=(\\S+)') AS pod, Timestamp AS ts, Body,
      dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(Timestamp, 1, toDateTime64(0, 9)) OVER (PARTITION BY pod ORDER BY Timestamp
                                                              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
               Timestamp) > 30 AS is_new
    FROM otel.otel_logs
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
      AND match(Body, '^\\S+Z prestop-drain pod=')
      AND LogAttributes['k8s.container.name'] != 'inspect'  -- scripts/lab/inspect-pvc.sh re-prints old drain logs
  )
)
GROUP BY pod, session
ORDER BY prestop_start, pod

panels.title: V2 vmagent data continuity: max gap between stored samples per avalanche target
panels.description: Max interval between adjacent stored (deduplicated) up samples over the whole time range, read back from vmselect. 5 s = perfect. A reshard handover adds up to ~8.5 s. A removed shard whose queue was lost leaves a gap roughly as long as the outage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp, Body AS body
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND match(Body, '^\\S+Z prestop-drain pod=')
      AND LogAttributes['k8s.container.name'] != 'inspect'  -- scripts/lab/inspect-pvc.sh re-prints old drain logs
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 300

panels.title: Per-pod buffer now (Vector)
panels.description: buffered_requests counts OTLP requests (one request holds many log lines) because of use_otlp_decoding.

targets.expr: (max by (pod) (kube_pod_deletion_timestamp{namespace="logging", pod=~"vector-[0-9]+"}) > bool 0) or on (pod) (max by (pod) (vector_buffer_size_events{namespace="logging", component_id="rotel"}) * 0)

panels.title: Disk buffer bytes per pod
panels.description: Vector exits as soon as its buffer is empty, so the last scraped point (every 10s) can still be above 0. Use V3/V4 for the verdict, not this line.

panels.title: V3 Vector shutdown verdict (one row per pod instance)
panels.description: SIGTERM -> sources stop -> the sink drains the disk buffer -> 'Vector has stopped.'. 'Failed to gracefully shut down in time' = hit VECTOR_GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_LIMIT_SECS; the rest stays on the PVC. One row per pod instance (sessions split at 'Vector has started').

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pod,
  minIf(ts, Body LIKE '%Signal received%') AS sigterm_at,
  maxIf(ts, Body LIKE '%Vector has stopped%') AS stopped_at,
  countIf(Body LIKE '%Failed to gracefully shut down in time%') AS forced_kills,
  if(stopped_at > sigterm_at, dateDiff('millisecond', sigterm_at, stopped_at) / 1000, NULL) AS shutdown_seconds,
  multiIf(forced_kills > 0, 'FAIL', stopped_at > sigterm_at, 'PASS', 'WAIT') AS verdict
FROM (
  SELECT LogAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, Timestamp AS ts, Body,
    sum(Body LIKE '%Vector has started%') OVER (PARTITION BY pod ORDER BY Timestamp
                                                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session
  FROM otel.otel_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
    AND LogAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'logging'
    AND LogAttributes['k8s.container.name'] = 'vector'
    AND (Body LIKE '%Signal received%' OR Body LIKE '%Vector has stopped%' OR Body LIKE '%Vector has started%'
         OR Body LIKE '%Failed to gracefully shut down in time%')
)
GROUP BY pod, session
HAVING countIf(Body LIKE '%Signal received%') > 0
ORDER BY sigterm_at

panels.title: V4 loggen end-to-end completeness (seq gaps per loggen pod)
panels.description: Each loggen pod writes a gap-free seq. missing = last - first + 1 - distinct. Only meaningful once every Vector buffer is 0; before that, lines still buffered on another pod show up as gaps. duplicates > 0 is fine (at-least-once retries).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  JSONExtractString(Body, 'pod') AS loggen_pod,
  count() AS rows,
  uniqExact(JSONExtractUInt(Body, 'seq')) AS distinct_seq,
  min(JSONExtractUInt(Body, 'seq')) AS first_seq,
  max(JSONExtractUInt(Body, 'seq')) AS last_seq,
  toInt64(last_seq) - toInt64(first_seq) + 1 - toInt64(distinct_seq) AS missing,
  toInt64(rows) - toInt64(distinct_seq) AS duplicates,
  if(missing = 0, 'PASS', 'FAIL') AS verdict
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND startsWith(Body, '{"level":"info","app":"loggen","pod":"')
GROUP BY loggen_pod
ORDER BY loggen_pod

SELECT Timestamp AS timestamp, Body AS body, LogAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
  AND LogAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'logging'
  AND LogAttributes['k8s.container.name'] = 'vector'
  AND (Body LIKE '%Signal received%' OR Body LIKE '%Shutting down%' OR Body LIKE '%has stopped%'
       OR Body LIKE '%Failed to gracefully%' OR Body LIKE '%Vector has started%')
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 300
